Access easily searchable meeting agendas and minutes for various boards, commissions, and committees.
Auditor
The auditor determines property values for taxing purposes and transferring real property deeds.
Clerk of Courts
On this site you can find information pertaining to the Clerk of Courts – Legal Department and Title Department. You can also find information on obtaining U.S. Passports and becoming a Notary Public. You will also find various printable forms.
Commissioners
Meet the Commissioners who help run Hancock County.
Common Pleas Court
Discover more about the Common Pleas Court in Hancock County.
Coroner
Deaths which are the result of criminal or other violent means, or by casualty, or by suicide, or suddenly when in apparent good health, or in any suspicious or unusual manner are under the jurisdiction of the Coroner.
Engineer
The Hancock County Engineer’s Office is responsible for all of the bridges and county roadways in Hancock County.
Probate / Juvenile Court
Discover more about Probate and the Juvenile Court.
Prosecutor
Learn more about the Hancock County Prosecutor and their responsibilities.
Recorder
The County Recorder is required to record and maintain accurate land records that are current, legible, and easily accessible.
Sheriff
Committed to serving our community with professionalism, integrity, and excellence.
Treasurer
The County Treasurer is the collector and safe keeper of all taxes collected in taxing districts such as schools, cities, townships, and villages.
